summary: Verified the upgraded category-specific /api/s/{qrid} scan landing page end-to-end against the in-workspace backend at EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL. Backend pytest: 26/26 pass. Strengthened the three scan-page tests to also assert the new category-specific DATA keys (vehicle: number_plate/vehicle_type/make_model/color/lost_mode/reward_text; tag: name/tag_type/blood_group/description/reward_text/lost_mode; card: display_name/title/company/phone) AND that the finder POST endpoints wired into the HTML page actually create incidents/alerts visible on the owner's dashboard. Live browser verification (390x844): (1) VEHICLE qr → red LOST banner, plate title, 5 reason buttons (Wrong parking / Accident / Lights / Suspicious / I found it), tapping a reason reveals the 'Send to owner' form with reason-specific placeholder and location-share checkbox; POST /api/public/qr/{qr}/incident 200 and count increments in owner GET /api/incidents. (2) TAG qr (lost + reward) → red LOST banner, name 'TEST_Bag_Updated', reward chip '🎁 TEST_reward_500', description pill, 'FOUND THIS? LET THE OWNER KNOW' + Send-to-owner form; POST /api/public/tag/{qr}/alert type=found 200 and message shows up in owner GET /api/alerts. (3) CARD qr → purple ICE banner '🪪 Emergency / contact card', green 'Call TEST_Card' anchor with href=tel:+911111111111, title/company subtitle, and the message form with Name/Phone/Message → POST /api/public/card/{qr}/message 200 and message shows up in owner GET /api/alerts. (4) Unknown qr /api/s/garbage-unknown-id → 200 text/html with 'Not registered' friendly card (DATA=null), NOT a raw JSON 404. Regression: JSON resolvers /api/public/qr/{qr} and /api/public/card/{qr} still 200 for real ids and /api/public/qr/deadbeef0000 still 404. Frontend light regression: login with demo@neksathi.app/demo1234 lands on /security with Smart QR segment pre-selected, Vehicles/Tags/ICE Cards chips, seeded MH01AB1234 visible plus TEST_* lost vehicles, bottom-tab order Security→Home→Family→Safety→Profile intact, no red screen, no page errors.
action_items: No functional fixes required. Category-specific scan page (vehicle reasons / tag found+reward / card call+message) works end-to-end, all POST /api/public/* endpoints wired by the HTML page succeed, and unknown QR still returns friendly HTML.

(Nice-to-have) The scan page currently has no <meta name='theme-color'>; adding one (e.g., #06060f matching --bg) would make the browser chrome match on iOS/Android when a bystander opens the QR link.

(Nice-to-have) On the card page, if DATA.phone is missing there is no visible fallback beyond the message form — main agent may want to render a subtle 'No direct number shared' pill so the intent is clearer.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:788-956 (SCAN_PAGE) is now ~170 lines of HTML+CSS+JS. It's a single Python string with double-escaped JS quotes (isn\'t, \''+sendUrl+'\'). Rendering was verified via browser and pytest — no SyntaxError, no console errors. If it grows further consider moving to a separate .html template loaded from disk to avoid quoting hazards.

server.py:884-902 renderVehicle emits distinct reason keys (wrong_parking, accident, lights_on, theft, found, other). Backend POST /api/public/qr/{qr}/incident accepts arbitrary `type` string so all 5 buttons work — verified for wrong_parking + accident in this run.

server.py:918-935 renderCard hard-codes the message form; DATA.phone is embedded raw in a tel: href — currently HTML-escaped via esc(). Phone values in DB should still be validated at write-time (they already are via Pydantic).
server.py:950 render() fallback string 'This QR code isn\'t linked…' — single-quote is JS-escaped, JSON.parse embeds DATA=null correctly, browser confirmed no error.
app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx + app/(tabs)/security.tsx — unchanged since iteration_4; login still lands on Security → Smart QR (confirmed with data-testid=login-submit-button).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (scan pages for vehicle/tag/card/unknown all render as designed; login → Security → Smart QR regression clean)

seed_data_creation: Reused demo user's existing vehicles/tags/cards. Test run added transient TEST_* incidents/alerts (scanner_note 'TEST_scanpage_wrongpark', 'TEST_scanpage_tag_found', 'TEST_scanpage_card_msg') to demo user's dashboard for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The scan page is now category-aware. When adding new categories (or new reason buttons for vehicle), keep DATA.kind in {vehicle, tag_guardian, card} and add a corresponding renderX() branch in render(). The client fetches are same-origin relative POSTs to /api/public/qr|tag|card/{qr}, so no CORS setup is needed. Playwright note: the frontend login screen uses testIDs login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button — use those directly instead of role=button (get_by_role returns 0 matches on Expo RN-Web).
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration was a feature verification, not a bug hunt. Prior root cause (native camera QR opening a JSON 404) remains fixed by GET /api/s/{qrid} always returning 200 text/html with an embedded JSON DATA constant; this iteration confirmed the upgraded UX (category-specific actions + owner reachability) works and does not regress the existing JSON resolvers.
